feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: The legacy of the 1991 Gulf War and the Americans who carried out the mission
entry.summary: 35 years since the Gulf War ended, veterans reflect on the conflict and its ongoing impact.

entry.title: A Kennedy relative talks about his family's lawsuit against Trump's 250-foot arch
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Max Kennedy, son of Robert Kennedy Sr., about the Kennedy family's lawsuit to halt the construction of President Trump's 250-foot arch near Arlington National Cemetery.

entry.title: Parts of a historic ghost town face demolition by the National Park Service
entry.summary: Part of a historic town owned by the Park Service is set for demolition as residents oppose the move.

entry.title: How the midterm election results could impact Elon Musk's many business interests in Texas
entry.summary: In recent years, Texas Republicans have enthusiastically welcomed Elon Musk and his companies to their state. Would that change when Democrats take charge of the state government?

entry.title: Why is gasoline suddenly under $4 a gallon?
entry.summary: The average price of a gallon of gasoline dipped below $4 this week for the first time in months. Does that mean more relief is coming for drivers?

entry.title: Kennedy relatives join the fight against Trump's arch, alleging harm to JFK's grave
entry.summary: Nine members of the Kennedy family have joined the legal fight against Trump's D.C. arch, arguing it would disrupt views and cast shadows over their ancestors' graves at Arlington National Cemetery.

entry.title: Following big Democratic wins, these swing voters are looking for results
entry.summary: For the swing voters NPR is regularly checking in with as part of its Swing Shift series, the election results brought mixed emotions, as does the pending Democratic control of Congress.

entry.title: Oil giant ExxonMobil left Venezuela years ago. Now it's considering a return
entry.summary: ExxonMobil has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Venezuelan government and its state-owned oil company to explore opportunities in the country.

entry.title: U.S. officials look to Europe to learn how to make prison better
entry.summary: American prison officials are looking to European nations like Germany and Norway for a roadmap on how to design a prison that emphasizes rehabilitation and a successful return to life on the outside.

entry.title: Swatters are using AI voices to deceive 911 dispatchers, and it's only getting worse
entry.summary: Swatters are increasingly using AI technology that creates synthetic voices or sound effects to generate remarkably believable fake emergency calls to law enforcement.
